_why: One table, read by both test suites. How long a process has been running is formatted twice -- once in Rust for the terminal (ork-cli::processes::how_long) and once in TypeScript for the window (apps/desktop/src/lib/time.ts::compactDuration) -- because a round trip to the back end for every row of a two-hundred-row list is not worth paying to avoid a second copy of six lines. Two copies of six lines drift. Two copies checked against the same table cannot: the drift becomes a failing test in whichever language moved.
_format: seconds -> the string both implementations must produce
